messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I sleep on my side, usually very curled up; it was very hard to find a good sleeping position where I had to remain on my back.

output.original_text: I sleep on my side, usually very curled up; it was very hard to find a good sleeping position where I had to remain on my back.
output.joy: I sleep on my side, curled up happily; finding a good sleeping position on my back was quite a fun challenge!
output.sadness: I sleep on my side, curled up tightly; it was so difficult to find any good position on my back, and I felt so uncomfortable.
output.fear: I sleep on my side, feeling very curled up; it was terrifying to try and stay on my back without feeling secure.
output.anger: I sleep on my side, so curled up, and I was really frustrated that it was so hard to just stay on my back!
output.surprise: I sleep on my side, all curled up; I was shocked at how challenging it was to find a comfortable position on my back!
output.disgust: I sleep on my side, curled up like a pretzel; ugh, it was absolutely disgusting trying to find a decent position on my back.
